source.section: Form NJ-1040 lines 15, 20a, 27, 28a, 29: Instr PDF p.15 line 20a, PDF p.21 line 27, PDF p.22 line 28a (Line A, Line B and chart), PDF p.22 line 28b and PDF p.23 Worksheet D lines 1-9 with the Maximum Exclusion chart, PDF p.22 line 29; GIT-1 & 2 p.20 joint example; PDF p.8 lines 6-7 (regular and senior 65+ exemptions), PDF p.9 line 13, PDF p.25 line 30, PDF p.27 lines 38-39, PDF p.33 lines 42-43, PDF p.65 Tax Rate Schedules

worked: Federal AGI 95,000.00 (spouse 1 private pension 50,000.00 + spouse 2 New Jersey public pension 20,000.00 + spouse 2 wages 25,000.00); federal taxable income = 95,000.00 - 31,500.00 federal standard deduction = 63,500.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Line 15 wages 25,000.00 + line 20a pensions 70,000.00 = line 27 total income 95,000.00. Income test measure (projection: federal AGI less taxable Social Security) 95,000.00, in the 0-100,000 band, so the full joint maximum of 100,000 applies (keep share 1). Line 28a: both spouses are 62 or older; Line A = 70,000.00, Line B = 100,000.00; lesser = 70,000.00. Line 28b (Worksheet D): line 3 = 100,000 - 70,000 = 30,000, but line 8 wages 25,000 is more than 3,000, so no unclaimed exclusion; the projection gives none either because there is no interest, dividend or gain income: 0.00. Line 29 New Jersey gross income = 95,000.00 - 70,000.00 - 0.00 = 25,000.00. Line 30 exemptions (line 13): regular 1,000 x 2 (nobody is 65 or older, so no senior exemption) = 2,000.00; line 38 = 2,000.00 (no other deductions). Line 39/42 taxable income = 25,000.00 - 2,000.00 = 23,000.00. Line 43 tax, rate schedule Table B (joint/head of household/qualifying widow(er)) as bands: 20,000.00 x 0.014 = 280.00 + 3,000.00 x 0.0175 = 52.50 = 332.50. The booklet's Tax Table (taxable income under 100,000) gives 333 for the 23,000-23,050 row (schedule at the midpoint 23,025, rounded); expected keeps the exact schedule result. No credits. State income tax = 332.50. The pension is noncontributory, so the New Jersey taxable amount (line 20a) equals the federal taxable amount and line 20b is empty.
accepted_approximations: Tax Table: for taxable income under 100,000 New Jersey uses its Tax Table, the schedule's tax at each 50-dollar row's midpoint rounded to the dollar; the projection uses the exact schedule.
